Executed 48 of 64 test cases for Company Details against the qa environment as a Global Admin. Identified 7 distinct defects ranked P1/P2/P3. The most consequential is Defect #4 (SN-6-FE004, P1): the Cancel button neither shows the unsaved-changes discard dialog (AC-E5) nor navigates to the Settings hub (AC-E6) -- it is a local form reset only, so four navigation/guard TCs fail on one root cause. A second cluster, SN-6-FE005 (P2), is structural: all 8 inputs lack a maxlength attribute, so every boundary-cap TC falls back to server-side validation instead of the spec's silent client cap. 14 BLOCKED TCs are waiting on LOCAL_ADMIN / MANAGER / EMPLOYEE credential provisioning (and API key) in .env.qa; 0 SKIPPED TCs require browser network interception or two concurrent sessions that the Playwright MCP cannot drive.

SN-6-FE004 -- Cancel does not show discard dialog or navigate to Settings hub

#5 SN-6-FE005 P2

SN-6-FE005 -- All 8 inputs missing maxLength; fields accept over-limit characters

Every text input reports maxLength = -1. Spec AC-E7 / E-2 require a silent client-side cap via the maxlength attribute (input simply stops at the limit, no error). Instead the field accepts arbitrary length and the server validates, returning errors like "LegalName must not exceed 200 characters.". Affects legal name (200), website (500), address (500), first name (100), last name (100), preferred name (100), work email (254), and phone (30).

#7 SN-6-FE007 P1

SN-6-FE007 -- Silent failure on save error: no error toast for HTTP 403 or 500

When PUT /company returns HTTP 403 (permission denied) or a mocked 500 (server error), the UI shows no error toast and no visual feedback whatsoever. The form data is preserved but the admin has no indication the save failed. Spec S14 requires a "Failed to save. Please try again." toast on any save error. This is a cross-cutting regression identified in the 2026-06-05 run: the prior run (2026-06-03) did show a toast for mocked 500 (TC-035 PASS). Now both 403 and 500 are swallowed silently. Note: the 403 itself is caused by a test environment permission gap (johnangelol lacks company.details.edit on Test TH Regional) — but the silent failure is a separate product defect that would affect any real admin whose save is rejected.

Affected Test Cases

  • TC-035 -- Save error -- error toast + form preserved (primary)
  • TC-E10 -- Network timeout during save -- error toast shown

Spec refs

S14, AC-E1 (analogous)

Discovery Findings

1. "Profile" vs "Details" naming drift. The route is /settings/company-profile and the save toast says "Company profile saved", while the spec, sidebar label, and page title use "Company Details". The implementation appears to have been built against an earlier "Company Profile" name (defects SN-6-FE001, SN-6-FE002).

2. Validation is server-authoritative, not client-capped. No input has a maxlength attribute; over-limit values are accepted in the field and rejected by the API. This contradicts AC-E7/E-2 (silent client cap) and produces a worse UX -- and in the phone case (SN-6-FE006) the server rejection surfaces no toast at all.

3. Cancel is a form-reset, not a navigation+guard. The single biggest gap (SN-6-FE004): no discard dialog, no Settings-hub navigation, and no beforeunload guard (TC-E12).

4. Environment session drift. The persistent browser profile was logged in as Richard Losande in tenant "Acme SG Central", and the company record is "Test Company TH" -- not the "richardtest / Jarinee Punpeang / EcoFlow Corp" identity the test cases assume. Behavior was judged on observed UI, not literal spec strings.

5. Positive coverage is solid. Required-field validation, URL/email format checks, role dropdown, Thai-script acceptance (no mojibake), partial-edit carry-forward (AC-E8), no-change save (E-9), and the absence of legal_name_local (E-13) all pass.

Recommendations

  1. File the P1 (SN-6-FE004) and P2 defects to dev via /qa-file-bug-jira SN-6.
  2. Provision LOCAL_ADMIN (entity admin), MANAGER, and EMPLOYEE accounts in .env.qa to unblock the 9 read-only / RBAC TCs (TC-005..011, TC-013, TC-014, TC-046).
  3. Configure E2E_API_KEY + actor headers + E2E_AUTH_CLIENT_ID so the orchestrator can run the 2 API permission TCs (TC-044-API, TC-045-API).
  4. Re-run TC-015 / TC-016 / TC-035 / TC-E10 / TC-E5 with a tool that supports network interception and multi-session (these were skipped under MCP).
  5. After fixes land, re-run /qa-test run SN-6 --failed to verify the 15 failures close.
